Checks behind the Method section and Appendix A: demographics, differential attrition by condition, differential exclusion of
speeders, the evidence-count measure, and post hoc power and sensitivity for the pairwise condition comparisons. The sample and
attrition tables the supplement reads are produced by `03a_method_descriptives.R`.

## Differential Attrition

```{r DA summary both studies}

df_all$messageType <- factor(df_all$messageType)
df_all$ConditionFeedback <- factor(df_all$ConditionFeedback)
df_all$ConditionChat <- factor(df_all$ConditionChat)


da.all.s1 <- df_all %>% filter(ScreenedDummy == 0, Study == 1)
da.all.s2 <- df_all %>% filter(ScreenedDummy == 0,Study == 2)

da.s1$messageType = relevel(da.s1$messageType,ref="Qualtrics  + Adversarial Dialogue")
da.s2$ConditionFeedback = relevel(da.s2$ConditionFeedback,ref="Control")



#summaries

table(da.s1$AttritDurExp, da.s1$messageType)
nice_table(as.data.frame(prop.table(table(da.s1$AttritDurExp, da.s1$messageType),margin = 2)*100) %>%
             filter(Var1 == 1, Var2 != "Chat + Control") %>%
             select(-(Var1)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Condition = Var2,
                "Attrition Rate" = Freq))

table(da.s2$AttritDurExp, da.s2$ConditionFeedback)
nice_table(as.data.frame(prop.table(table(da.s2$AttritDurExp, da.s2$ConditionFeedback),margin = 2)*100) %>%
             filter(Var1 == 1, Var2 != "Belief & Values-Tailored") %>%
             select(-(Var1)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Condition = Var2,
                "Attrition Rate" = Freq))
```

## Differential Speeder Exclusion by Condition

The preregistration states: "If differential exclusion is observed (i.e., if the 'speeders' are disproportionately
found in the treatment condition), we will perform sensitivity analyses to see how the results change if the speeders are
included." The 10-minute exclusion is not applied to the primary sample (the sensitivity models that apply it are in the
"save models for supplement" chunk of `05_results_effects.Rmd`). The tests below check whether speeders (completion time of
600 seconds or less) are distributed differently across conditions, mirroring the differential-attrition tests above.

```{r differential speeder exclusion, warning=FALSE}

da.s1 <- da.s1 %>%
  mutate(Speeder = if_else(`Duration (in seconds)` <= 600, 1, 0, missing = NA))
da.s2 <- da.s2 %>%
  mutate(Speeder = if_else(`Duration (in seconds)` <= 600, 1, 0, missing = NA))

table(da.s1$Speeder, da.s1$messageType)
prop.table(table(da.s1$Speeder, da.s1$ConditionFeedback), margin = 2) * 100

table(da.s2$Speeder, da.s2$ConditionFeedback)
prop.table(table(da.s2$Speeder, da.s2$ConditionFeedback), margin = 2) * 100

# chi-square version  - nothing sig
report(chisq.test(da.s1$Speeder, da.s1$messageType))
report(chisq.test(da.s1$Speeder, da.s1$ConditionChat))
report(chisq.test(da.s1$Speeder, da.s1$ConditionFeedback))

report(chisq.test(da.s2$Speeder, da.s2$ConditionFeedback))

# logistic regression version  - nothing sig
res_speed_s1 <- clean_regress(
  da.s1,
  dvs = "Speeder",
  type = "logistic",
  predictors = ~ messageType,
  dv_labels = c(Speeder = "Study 1 Speeder Exclusion")
)
cr_table(res_speed_s1, style = "stargazer")

res_speed_s2 <- clean_regress(
  da.s2,
  dvs = "Speeder",
  type = "logistic",
  predictors = ~ ConditionFeedback,
  dv_labels = c(Speeder = "Study 2 Speeder Exclusion")
)
cr_table(res_speed_s2, style = "stargazer")

```

## Conversation Details
```{r evidence freq}

# quick distribution check
summary(df_convos$EvidenceFreq)
quantile(df_convos$EvidenceFreq, probs = c(.95, .975, .99), na.rm = TRUE)

# IQR rule
q1 <- quantile(df_convos$EvidenceFreq, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
q3 <- quantile(df_convos$EvidenceFreq, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
iqr <- q3 - q1
upper_iqr <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr

# cap based on ~600 words total 
cap <- 15

df_convos <- df_convos %>%
  mutate(
    EvidenceFreq_flag = EvidenceFreq > cap,
    EvidenceFreq_winsor = pmin(EvidenceFreq, cap)
  )


# winsorize
df_convos_winsor <- df_convos %>%
  mutate(EvidenceFreq = pmin(EvidenceFreq, cap))


#evidence frequency info
summary(df_convos_winsor$EvidenceFreq)
table(df_convos_winsor$EvidenceFreq)

prop.table(table(df_convos_winsor$EvidenceFreq, df_convos_winsor$ConditionFeedback),margin = 2) * 100

df_convos_winsor %>%
  group_by(ConditionFeedback) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(EvidenceFreq, na.rm = TRUE),
            SD = sd(EvidenceFreq, na.rm = TRUE))


df_convos_winsor %>%
  group_by(Study,ConditionFeedback) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(EvidenceFreq, na.rm = TRUE),
            SD = sd(EvidenceFreq, na.rm = TRUE))


```

## Post-Hoc Power Check

~80% power for Study 1 pairwise comparisons, ~52-56% for Study 2. target N reflected practical constraints and an expected d ~ 0.2 from Costello et al. (2024). This checks achieved power post hoc for each pairwise condition comparison, using pwr.t2n.test() since group sizes are unequal.

```{r power check, warning=FALSE}

pacman::p_load(pwr)

# actual per-condition n's in the analytic sample (the 10-minute exclusion is not applied)
n_cond <- table(df_both$Study, as.character(df_both$ConditionFeedback))
power_pairs <- tribble(
  ~Study, ~Comparison,                                      ~n1,                                 ~n2,
  1,      "Adversarial vs. Belief-Tailored",                n_cond["1", "Adversarial Dialogue"], n_cond["1", "Belief-Tailored"],
  1,      "Adversarial vs. Belief & Values-Tailored",       n_cond["1", "Adversarial Dialogue"], n_cond["1", "Belief & Values-Tailored"],
  1,      "Belief-Tailored vs. Belief & Values-Tailored",   n_cond["1", "Belief-Tailored"],      n_cond["1", "Belief & Values-Tailored"],
  2,      "Control vs. Adversarial",                        n_cond["2", "Control"],              n_cond["2", "Adversarial Dialogue"],
  2,      "Control vs. Belief-Tailored",                    n_cond["2", "Control"],              n_cond["2", "Belief-Tailored"],
  2,      "Adversarial vs. Belief-Tailored",                n_cond["2", "Adversarial Dialogue"], n_cond["2", "Belief-Tailored"]
)

d_expected <- 0.2  # conservative from study 1

power_check <- power_pairs %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(power = pwr.t2n.test(n1 = n1, n2 = n2, d = d_expected,
                               sig.level = 0.05, alternative = "two.sided")$power) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(power_pct = paste0(round(power * 100, 1), "%"))

power_check %>%
  kable(caption = "Post-hoc power to detect d = 0.2 by pairwise condition comparison", align = "l") %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Times New Roman") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "responsive"), font_size = 12)

# reverse: what n per arm (equal n) would be needed for 80% power at d = 0.2?
pwr.t.test(d = d_expected, sig.level = 0.05, power = 0.80, type = "two.sample", alternative = "two.sided") #1180 = 393 *3

#pre-post (paired) version ----
# type="paired" treats d as Cohen's d_z - the standardized mean of the PRE-POST DIFFERENCE scores (mean_diff / SD_diff), not the same quantity as the between-groups d = 0.2 used
pwr.t.test(d = d_expected, sig.level = 0.05, power = 0.80, type = "paired", alternative = "two.sided") #594 = 198*3
pwr.t.test(d = d_expected, sig.level = 0.05, power = 0.90, type = "paired", alternative = "two.sided")#795 = 265*3
pwr.t.test(d = d_expected, sig.level = 0.05, power = 0.95, type = "paired", alternative = "two.sided") #981 = 327*3

```

### Sensitivity Analysis
instead of assuming d = 0.2, checks what power we had

```{r sensitivity analysis, warning=FALSE}

sensitivity_check <- power_pairs %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(min_detectable_d = pwr.t2n.test(n1 = n1, n2 = n2, power = 0.80,
                                          sig.level = 0.05, alternative = "two.sided")$d) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(min_detectable_d = round(min_detectable_d, 3))

sensitivity_check %>%
  kable(caption = "Minimum detectable effect size at 80% power", align = "l") %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Times New Roman") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "responsive"), font_size = 12)

```
